title: Your Repositories Already Wrote Your Resume
subtitle: Repo2Reputation  ·  a Colaberry learner build
caption: A GitHub profile is already proof of what someone can do. Almost nobody reads it that way.
Sign in with GitHub. That is the entire setup.
Repositories import from one or more GitHub accounts, public or private.
Six phases analyse each repository. Every phase records its own status and its own error.
Nothing is written about a repository until it has been analysed.
